objective: Scan repository structure and key files (README, package/build configs, lint/test configs, main entrypoints) to locate one small maintainability defect; document where it occurs and propose a concrete fix with rationale.
success_criteria: Report identifies exactly one maintainability defect with file path(s)/line(s) or precise location, explains impact, and recommends a specific fix (including example diff snippet if helpful) without modifying repository files.
